app.name: Tallypress
app.tagline: Monthly sales, margin and cash for your WooCommerce shop

setupNeeded.title: No shop configured
setupNeeded.body: Create the dev shop with `npm run db:seed`, then reload this page.
setupNeeded.openingBody: Tallypress needs your starting bank balance and opening stock before it can show results.

overview.title: Shop overview
overview.roiHelp: Invested = opening stock value + all restocks.
overview.netRemainingHelp: Money in the account minus VAT, income tax and the cost of goods sold: opening balance + net earnings.
overview.cogs: Cost of goods sold so far

simulator.title: What can I spend? (simulation)
simulator.help: Move the percentage to see the effect live. Nothing changes until you save it as the default.
simulator.pct: Share of net earnings kept for personal use
simulator.restockHelp: Money in the account, minus VAT and tax set aside, minus the personal share still to take.

month.heading: Month
month.lateAdjustments: includes late changes to earlier months
month.missingCost: {n} sold line(s) have no purchase cost yet, so profit is overstated. Set it in Stock.
month.loss: Costs exceed the net revenue this month.

stock.title: Stock and purchase prices
stock.mismatch: differs from WooCommerce: was a restock not recorded?
stock.restockHelp: Adds the lot, blends it into the average cost, and takes the amount out of the shop account.
stock.manualHelp: For items with no purchase history, such as products without stock tracking.
stock.noItems: No products yet. Sync from WooCommerce in Setup.

ledger.title: Shop account movements
ledger.withdrawHelp: For example your salary or personal expenses. It is booked today.
ledger.salesNote: Sales are not listed here: they come from WooCommerce orders.

setup.openingDone: The starting point is recorded. Currency and starting point can no longer be changed.
setup.openingIntro: Choose the day Tallypress starts counting, the money in the shop account that day, and the stock you had with its purchase price (without VAT). Orders before that day are ignored.
setup.needSync: Sync from WooCommerce first, so the product list is available.
setup.openingWarn: This can be done only once.
